The proposed answer is wrong because the partial fraction coefficients were computed incorrectly.

Write f(x) = g(x)/((x−1)(x−2)(x−3)) with g(x) = (2025+x) ln(2025+x). The cover-up method gives:

- A = g(1)/((1−2)(1−3)) = 2026 ln 2026 / 2 = 1013 ln 2026
- B = g(2)/((2−1)(2−3)) = −2027 ln 2027
- C = g(3)/((3−1)(3−2)) = 2028 ln 2028 / 2 = 1014 ln 2028

The proposed solution skipped the factors in the denominator, so each of its coefficients is wrong.

The terms from x = 2 and x = 3 decay like 2^(−n) and 3^(−n). The x = 1 term gives d_n → −A = −1013 ln 2026 ≈ −7712.8.

The proposed answer, −2026 ln 2026 ≈ −15425.6, is twice the correct value.

VERDICT: REJECT
